items.title: Can you still tell AI-generated text apart in your own language?
items.raw_excerpt: I'm Japanese, and I can still usually spot AI-generated Japanese by its word choice. Some words, like 実務 (practical work) and 帳簿 (a ledger), turn up far more often than they should. Casual ones like 効く (to work well, to be effective) and 刺さる (to pierce > to resonate, to hit home) get used where another word would normally be the first choice. They're the Japanese equivalent of "delve." I'm not a native English speaker, but my impression is that AI-generated English has improved a lot recently and is harder to pick out than it used to be. Does that match what English native speakers see? What about other languages? Chinese must be one of the most heavily trained languages, so I'd expect it to have improved as much as English. items.title: 豆包“工作任务”升级，支持手机远程操控电脑
items.raw_excerpt: 近日豆包发布产品更新，“工作任务”模式新增手机远程控制电脑功能。同一账号授权后，用户在手机端下达任务指令，可以由已连接的电脑端读取本地文件、操作软件完成执行，进度和结果实时回传手机，帮助用户在通勤、离开工位等各类场景中自动执行任务，提升效率。   今年6月豆包上线“工作任务”模式，AI 可在授权后直接操作本地电脑和浏览器。此次更新把操控任务扩展到手机端，支持关联多台电脑，可跨设备调取文件。豆包官号演示的案例显示，外出时远程让电脑找到桌面文件、转成 PDF 回传；通勤途中让电脑继续未完成的数据分析、生成图表发到手机；所需文件分散在工作和家庭两台电脑时，分别调取后合并修改。 使用该功能需在豆包官网下载最新的“豆包电脑版”， 并将手机端豆包App更新至最新版，在“工作任务”模式中点击“云电脑”，并在对话运行环境中选择“添加新的本地电脑”完成授权。

Doubao recently released a product update, adding a mobile remote control feature for computers in its "Work Tasks" mode. After authorization with the same account, users can issue task commands from their phone, and a linked computer can read local files and operate software to complete the tasks, with progress and results sent back to the phone in real time. This helps users automatically execute tasks in scenarios such as commuting or away from their desk, improving efficiency.

In June this year, Doubao launched "Work Tasks" mode, allowing AI to directly operate local computers and browsers after authorization. This update extends control tasks to mobile, supports linking multiple computers, and enables cross-device file retrieval. Demos on Doubao's official account show users remotely having a computer find desktop files and convert them to PDF to send back; during a commute, having a computer continue unfinished data analysis and generate charts to send to the phone; and when files are scattered across work and home computers, retrieving them separately and merging edits.

To use this feature, users need to download the latest "Doubao Computer Version" from the official website, update the mobile Doubao app to the latest version, click "Cloud Computer" in "Work Tasks" mode, and select "Add New Local Computer" in the conversation runtime environment to complete authorization.

excerpt_i18n.en: On August 17, Alibaba released the AI music model HappyShrimp (Chinese name: Kuaile Xiami).
